messages:
Ana: FYI seeing a burst of Pending GPU pods in prod-gpu-01 (us-west-2a). ClusterAutoscaler not scaling up, events show AZ quota errors.
Kevin: Which message in the autoscaler logs?
Ana: quick extract: 
```
I0318 14:18:34.123456 1 scale_up.go:145] Not scaling: couldn't find node group to scale: quota exceeded for zone us-west-2a (GPUs)
```
Kevin: ugh. Is this an AZ quota or regional GPU quota?
infra-ci-bot: Autoscaler alert: metric=pending_gpu_pods count=17 cluster=prod-gpu-01 threshold=10 since=2m
Sumi: If AZ quota is 0, CA won't create nodes in that AZ. Can we let it pick other AZs in the same region?
Tom: Our policy intentionally prefers same-AZ to keep KV cache local and minimize cross-AZ egress. Cross-AZ routing for GPU workloads is disabled by default.
Kevin: For immediate relief we could bring up a small emergency nodepool in us-west-2b (on-demand) and set ClusterAutoscaler to include it. That's faster than filing quota increase.
Sumi: Agree. Also we should consider a graceful cross-az fallback policy for spikes: prefer same-AZ, fall back to other AZs when pending pods & queue backlog > X.
Ana: Trying to patch a temporary nodepool. Command I used: 
```
# create nodepool with 2x a100 on us-west-2b
gcloud container node-pools create emergency-gpu-b --cluster prod-gpu-01 --num-nodes=2 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --zone=us-west-2b --metadata=preemptible=false
```
Autoscaler-bot: Suggestion: add emergency-gpu-b to CA config and set --ok-total-unready-count=500 to avoid premature scale-down. Also consider `scaleDownUtilizationThreshold` tweak.
Tom: Cost note: cross-AZ routing will increase egress for model KV cache; estimate ~0.015 USD/GB per request path if cache misses spike. Keep in mind for long-running failovers.
Kevin: For a safer long-term approach: 1) track per-AZ GPU quota and pre-provision small buffer (min:1-2 nodes per region) 2) add policy in CA to allow cross-AZ expand only when pending_gpu_pods > 5 for 30s 3) add alert on AZ quota approaching 90%.
Sumi: I'll draft a runbook: steps to spin emergency pool, update CA, and rollback. Also add a Grafana panel for pending_gpu_pods by zone.
Chris: Can you paste the final autoscaler log lines after the nodepool came up? need to attach to incident notes.
Ana: After creating emergency pool, CA log: 
```
I0318 14:19:52.987654 1 scale_up.go:260] Scale-up: nodegroup emergency-gpu-b, adding 2 nodes
I0318 14:22:11.001234 1 scale_up.go:312] Successfully added 2 nodes to emergency-gpu-b
```
Ana: Pods started scheduling. Observed a small latency spike (~120ms tail p99) for inference due to KV cache misses when pods landed in different AZ. Workaround: pre-warm cache on new nodes.
Kevin: Good catch. After we stabilize, open a ticket to evaluate pre-warm vs reserved capacity tradeoffs (cost vs cold-start latency).
Sumi: Will do. I'll also add a short policy doc for CA behavior and emergency nodepool naming conventions.
Tom: TL;DR: immediate fix = emergency us-west-2b pool + CA include, medium = cross-AZ fallback with thresholds, long = quota monitoring + regional reserved buffer.
Ana: Closing the thread — new pool is up and pending cleared. I'll post the PR for the runbook in #eng-infra later. :thumbsup:
